Pct. 6 constable's office employee involved in deadly road rage shooting on Highway 90, HCSO says
stories.summary: A 35-year-old man was shot and killed during a road rage incident on Highway 90 in Crosby. HCSO says the shooter works for a constable's office.

stories.title: Deadly shooting at Katy-area Airbnb prompts new security measures, concerns from neighbors
stories.summary: One man was killed and another injured during a party at a short-term rental in the Windstone Colony neighborhood.

stories.title: Houston's Pancho Claus remains hospitalized as doctors investigate possible brain mass
stories.summary: Houston's Pancho Claus remains hospitalized as doctors investigate a possible brain mass. Despite his health concerns, he's focused on helping children.

stories.title: Man accused of killing girlfriend with U-Haul held without bond
stories.summary: Bobby Joe McCullah Jr. is being held without bond on a murder charge in the death of his girlfriend, Amber Mauceli, who was struck by a U-Haul.

stories.title: Dogs responsible for killing 3 animals at Houston-area high school barn, district says
stories.summary: Dogs killed a goat and two pigs belonging to Aldine students at a shared school barn. The district said it is strengthening security.

stories.title: $5,000 reward offered in hit-and-run that killed woman walking home from work on FM 1960
stories.summary: Investigators previously described the vehicle as a white four-door sedan. Reese’s wife is urging anyone with information to come forward.

stories.title: Missing 13-year-old found after license plate alert in Bellaire; driver faces sexual assault charge
stories.summary: Police said a license plate reader flagged a vehicle linked to the missing child. The driver was later charged with aggravated sexual assault of a child.

stories.title: Be Someone’s Secret Santa. Help Make the Holidays Brighter for Houston Families.
stories.summary: Join KHOU 11 in our Secret Santa toy drive.

stories.title: Driver killed in crash with Alvin ISD school bus, Texas DPS says | No one on bus hurt
stories.summary: Texas DPS said an SUV driver is dead after a head-on collision with an Alvin ISD school bus.

stories.title: Grand jury to weigh charges after Houston resident fatally shoots man in Halloween costume
stories.summary: A grand jury will weigh charges against a Houston apartment resident in the fatal shooting of 36-year-old Joshua Winkelmann.

stories.title: 'I hope her story can save someone' | Friends remember Texas mother killed aboard cruise ship
stories.summary: Friends remember Susan Watford, a Texas mother of three killed aboard a cruise ship, and hope her story raises awareness about domestic violence.
